private androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher<com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions> _oniScannerLauncher = null;
private androidx.activity.result.ActivityResultLauncher<String> _oniPermLauncher = null;

private void initScanner() {
    if (_oniScannerLauncher != null && _oniPermLauncher != null) return;
    try {
        if (_oniPermLauncher == null) {
            _oniPermLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
                new androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
                new androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultCallback<Boolean>() {
                    @Override
                    public void onActivityResult(Boolean granted) {
                        if (granted != null && granted) {
                            _oniLaunchScanner();
                        }
                    }
                }
            );
        }
        if (_oniScannerLauncher == null) {
            _oniScannerLauncher = registerForActivityResult(
                new com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanContract(),
                new androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultCallback<com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanIntentResult>() {
                    @Override
                    public void onActivityResult(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanIntentResult result) {
                        if (result != null && result.getContents() != null) {
                            final String barcode = result.getContents();
                            webView.post(new Runnable() {
                                public void run() {
                                    try {
                                        org.json.JSONObject obj = new org.json.JSONObject();
                                        obj.put("barcode", barcode);
                                        String js = "if(window.onBarcodeScanned){try{window.onBarcodeScanned(" + org.json.JSONObject.quote(obj.toString()) + ");}catch(e){}}";
                                        webView.evaluateJavascript(js, null);
                                    } catch (Exception ignored) {}
                                }
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            );
        }
    } catch (Exception e) {
        // ничего: если registerForActivityResult недоступен — сканер просто не сработает
    }
}

private void _oniLaunchScanner() {
    try {
        if (_oniScannerLauncher == null) return;
        com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions options = new com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions();
        options.setDesiredBarcodeFormats(com.journeyapps.barcodescanner.ScanOptions.ALL_CODE_TYPES);
        options.setPrompt("Наведите камеру на штрихкод");
        options.setBeepEnabled(false);
        options.setOrientationLocked(true);
        _oniScannerLauncher.launch(options);
    } catch (Exception e) {}
}

@JavascriptInterface
public void scanBarcode() {
    runOnUiThread(new Runnable() {
        public void run() {
            try {
                if (checkSelfPermission(android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    if (_oniPermLauncher == null) initScanner();
                    if (_oniPermLauncher == null) return;
                    _oniPermLauncher.launch(android.Manifest.permission.CAMERA);
                    return;
                }
                if (_oniScannerLauncher == null) initScanner();
                _oniLaunchScanner();
            } catch (Exception e) {}
        }
    });
}
